args.prompt: Wide shot of a pebble beach beneath tall cliffs on the south coast of England in winter, several damaged shipping containers washed up on the shore, cargo scattered on the stones: wooden wine barrels, cardboard boxes, a few motorcycles on their sides; a large stricken container ship listing offshore in a grey sea, overcast January light. Photoreal documentary cinematography, natural light, realistic scale and physics, sharp detail, no text, no logos, no brand names.
